description: Hidden Gem - Organizations ranked by org-owned and member-owned repo scores

options.content: **Window:** last ${hours}h · `org_*` columns aggregate repos where the organization itself is owner. `member_*` columns aggregate repos owned by the org's members (from `organization_members`). Both are computed over the same window and filter set. · Filters: lang=${language}, license=${license}, topic=${topic}

targets.rawSql: SELECT org_login, org_repos_total_score FROM hidden_gem_org_scores(${alpha}::float, ${beta}::float, ${hours}::int, CASE WHEN '${language:csv}' = '__all__' THEN NULL::text[] ELSE string_to_array('${language:csv}', ',') END, CASE WHEN '${license:csv}' = '__all__' THEN NULL::text[] ELSE string_to_array('${license:csv}', ',') END, CASE WHEN '${topic:csv}' = '__all__' THEN NULL::text[] ELSE string_to_array('${topic:csv}', ',') END) WHERE org_repos_total_score > 0 ORDER BY org_repos_total_score DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

SELECT org_login, member_repos_total_score FROM hidden_gem_org_scores(${alpha}::float, ${beta}::float, ${hours}::int, CASE WHEN '${language:csv}' = '__all__' THEN NULL::text[] ELSE string_to_array('${language:csv}', ',') END, CASE WHEN '${license:csv}' = '__all__' THEN NULL::text[] ELSE string_to_array('${license:csv}', ',') END, CASE WHEN '${topic:csv}' = '__all__' THEN NULL::text[] ELSE string_to_array('${topic:csv}', ',') END) WHERE member_repos_total_score > 0 ORDER BY member_repos_total_score DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

SELECT org_login, org_repos_total_score, org_repos_best_score, org_active_repos, org_hidden_gem_count, member_repos_total_score, member_repos_best_score, member_active_repos, member_active_users, member_hidden_gem_count FROM hidden_gem_org_scores(${alpha}::float, ${beta}::float, ${hours}::int, CASE WHEN '${language:csv}' = '__all__' THEN NULL::text[] ELSE string_to_array('${language:csv}', ',') END, CASE WHEN '${license:csv}' = '__all__' THEN NULL::text[] ELSE string_to_array('${license:csv}', ',') END, CASE WHEN '${topic:csv}' = '__all__' THEN NULL::text[] ELSE string_to_array('${topic:csv}', ',') END) ORDER BY (org_repos_total_score + member_repos_total_score) DESC NULLS LAST;

list.name: language
list.label: Language
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT r.language AS value FROM events e JOIN repos r ON r.repo_id = e.repo_id WHERE e.time >= NOW() - (${hours} || ' hours')::interval AND r.language IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
